meta.name: lcx-report-bug
meta.description: Create a high-signal bug issue or PR in the repo that owns the defect. Use this whenever the user asks to report, file, open, or triage a LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, Codex plugin, or upstream Codex CLI bug, especially when they need source-backed root cause, reproduction steps, fix guidance, and GitHub routing.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动创建带根因分析和复现步骤的缺陷报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在GitHub仓库中提交高质量Bug Issue或修复PR。
copy.tagline_en: Automatically create bug reports with root cause analysis and reproduction steps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to file high-signal bug issues or fix PRs in GitHub repos.

howto.what: 安装后，当用户报告软件缺陷时，Claude 会先调查复现、定位出错的仓库，然后生成一份英文 GitHub issue 或 PR，包含环境、复现步骤、根因、修复建议，并打上 lazycodex-generated 标签。
howto.when: 当用户要求报告、提交、打开或分类 LazyCodex、Codex 插件或上游 Codex CLI 的 bug，尤其需要根因、复现步骤和 GitHub 路由时触发。

say.text: 帮我报告这个 bug：安装 LazyCodex 后启动失败，这是日志。
say.note: Claude 会先复现并定位仓库，再生成 issue。

say.text: 把这个问题做成 PR 提交到 openai/codex，带上修复代码。

howto.what_en: When installed, if the user reports a software bug, Claude investigates and reproduces it, routes it to the owning repo, and drafts an English GitHub issue or PR with environment, steps, root cause, fix guidance, and the lazycodex-generated label.
howto.when_en: When the user asks to report, file, open, or triage a bug in LazyCodex, a Codex plugin, or upstream Codex CLI, especially when they need root cause, reproduction steps, and GitHub routing.

say_en.text: Report this bug: LazyCodex install fails to start. Here is the log.
say_en.note: Claude will reproduce, route, and draft an issue.

say_en.text: Should this route to openai/codex or code-yeongyu/lazycodex? Draft an issue.
say_en.note: It searches source evidence to decide ownership and drafts.

say_en.text: Open a PR against openai/codex with the fix code.
say_en.note: Only creates a PR there if the fix is implemented.
